description:
draft-ietf-mls-combiner (combiner-02), Application Messages / Wire formats. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-combiner at 380f0e1, L332.

Text: "Application messages are therefore only sent in the traditional session"

Problem: This is not normative, and receivers have no rule for application messages sent in the PQ session, so implementations may differ on accepting them.

Suggested fix: State that application messages MUST NOT be sent in the PQ session, and that receivers MUST reject them.

Severity: low. Verifier: keep (Confirmed. Line 332 is descriptive, with no MUST and no receiver rule, and line 607 restricts only paired messages, so standalone PQ-session application messages are unaddressed.)
